taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: Dependency confusion and package-source selection — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Read manifest/lockfile, index/source priorities, scopes, registry configuration and installer version. Inspect resolution without executing install hooks or publishing package names.
controls.controlled_verification: Use local registry metadata/fixture names or a supported resolution-only path to determine which source/version wins for one private dependency. Compare the intended private source and an untrusted candidate under the exact configured resolver; do not assume all managers rank sources identically.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An unregistered public name is not proof of dependency confusion. A lockfile, source binding, private index policy or scoped package ownership may prevent the hypothesized resolution.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind packages to approved sources/ownership and preserve reproducibility/integrity. Retest intended updates and the exact ambiguous-source resolution without executing untrusted packages.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
